about: Expected two-site spectra of the shipped synthetic panel (tiny_geno.tsv: 12 individuals, 24 sites with random genotypes; tiny_anc.tsv: its synthetic polarization table, 22 sites with an ancestral call of which 3 low-confidence, 2 with none; tiny_map.bedgraph: a synthetic genetic map over the same coordinates with six intervals at 0.5-3 cM/Mb, one uncovered gap holding 2 sites, one 1-kb interval at 50 cM/Mb, plus one interval of another chromosome that the filter must skip) under the parameters in 'params', chosen so that every pair class occurs: 276 pairs = 2 mnv_control (bp distance <= 500) + 45 na_gap_excluded + 121 hotspot_control + 9 out_of_bin_range + 99 signal in 4 cM bins over 5 jackknife blocks of 20 kb. 'default' is the full estimate() comparand (all confidence classes oriented: 22 sites, 81 signal pairs with both sites oriented); 'high_conf_only' orients the 19 high-confidence sites only (57 such pairs) and lists the unfolded register, the folded one being identical to 'default' by construction. phi_exact and qhat_exact are exact rationals 'p/q'; qhat, se and ci95 are the floats computed from them. Row index = derived (or minor) allele count at the site with the smaller position, column = at the other site.
